title: The sushi restaurant: the neighborhood's diners (assumed)
name: the sushi restaurant
about: A small neighborhood sushi restaurant with no reservations: four counter seats and one table of four.
note: Every number here is an assumption written to fit the cast's bios and to fill the room as the one-evening world does (36 people a Friday, in its group shares). The owner's own counts replace usualPerWeek, knows and weight. A day is a Friday evening, so a week is one day. A regular came on at least 2 of the last 4 Fridays.
